title: Audit log records successful authentication attempts
gherkin:
Feature: Audit Logging for Authentication
  Scenario: System logs successful user login
    Given a user with valid credentials exists
    When the user successfully authenticates
    Then an audit log entry is created
    And the audit log contains the timestamp of the login
    And the audit log contains the user identifier
    And the audit log contains the event type "authentication_success"
    And the audit log contains the event outcome "success"
rationale: Requirement 1.8.2 explicitly states the system shall log all user authentication attempts, including successful login attempts. This test verifies that successful authentications are properly recorded with required metadata.
usedContextItems: The system shall log all user authentication attempts, including successful and failed login attempts
